premises.title: Premises
premises.body: The owner leases to the tenant the commercial space "{{name}}"{{location}}, as listed on {{brand}}, for the tenant's business use.

rent.title: Rent and payment
rent.body: The monthly rent is {{rent}}, due on the {{day}} of each month starting on the start date. Rent is paid online through {{brand}} ({{provider}}), which collects it on the owner's behalf; it can be paid from 7 days before each due date and is applied to the oldest unpaid month first. Each payment produces a receipt.

fee.title: {{brand}} service fee
fee.body: {{brand}} keeps {{rate}} of each monthly rent payment ({{fee}} of {{rent}}) as its service fee and transfers the rest ({{net}}) to the owner's bank account. The fee comes out of the owner's rent: the tenant pays exactly the monthly rent above and nothing more. The deposit carries no fee.

deposit.title: Deposit
deposit.body: The tenant gives the owner a security deposit of {{deposit}} before the start date. It is returned at the end of the lease, minus the cost of documented damages beyond normal wear.
deposit.none: No security deposit is required for this lease.

use.title: Use of the space
use.body: The tenant will use the space only for lawful commercial activity, keep the permits its business requires, and not sublet it without the owner's written consent.

maintenance.title: Maintenance
maintenance.body: The owner is responsible for structural repairs and the building's main installations. The tenant is responsible for day-to-day upkeep and for damage caused by its use of the space.

latePayment.title: Late payment
latePayment.body: If rent is not paid by its due date, {{brand}} sends reminders on the due date and after 7 and 15 days. No late fee applies unless one is stated in the special clauses.

earlyEnd.title: Ending the lease early
earlyEnd.body: Either party may ask to end the lease early through {{brand}}, stating a date and a reason. It only takes effect if the other party accepts; rent after the agreed end date is then removed.

renewal.title: Renewal
renewal.body: In the last 90 days of the lease either party may propose a renewal through {{brand}}. It takes effect when the owner's renewal offer is signed by the tenant; the new rent applies from the current end date. Otherwise the lease ends on the end date and the space becomes available again.

signature.title: Electronic signature
signature.body: Both parties accept that typing their full name and confirming through {{brand}}, recorded with the date and time, is their signature of this lease.
